title: Tensor Network-Based Machine Learning: Image Classification Benchmarks
description:
A reproducible, YAML-driven pipeline for image classification with tensor networks, developed as a BSc Physics bachelor's thesis (TFG) at Universidad Europea de Madrid, with an internship at ITCL.

The repository implements and compares four tensor-network architectures under identical data and training conditions: a reference Matrix Product State (MPS) baseline built on TensorKrowch; a custom hierarchical Tree Tensor Network (TTN); a hybrid TTN that interleaves PyTorch transformations (LayerNorm, Linear, ReLU) between tensor-network contraction levels to keep the model trainable; and an AIM spatial front-end that adds inductive bias before images are flattened into tensor-network sequences, inspired by Nie et al. (2025), Deep Tree Tensor Networks for Image Recognition.

The main dataset is ChemEq25 / Chemistry Lab Apparatus (Hossain et al., 2025), reformulated from an object-detection dataset into an instance-classification problem by cropping each annotated laboratory object from its YOLO annotations. Oxford Flowers 102 is retained as a preliminary benchmark. The pipeline includes checkpointing, metrics CSVs (accuracy, F1, recall), loss-curve plots and dataset audits for both datasets.
